# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech to Build Something](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal essay about quitting a stable tech job to pursue independent projects and adventures.

## Other

- [Claude Surf AI Development](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): AI-powered orchestrator for autonomous software development using Claude agents and Linear integration
- [Color Theory Guide](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice note on color theory principles, harmony schemes, and perceptual color spaces for design.
- [Martian Ideas Through History](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canal theories to modern spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized steel containers revolutionized global trade and enabled modern globalization economics.
- [Sourdough Science and Practice](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Explores sourdough starter microbiology, fermentation chemistry, and baking techniques comprehensively.
- [Ancient Eclipse Predicting Device](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient Greek geared calculator from 150-100 BCE that predicted eclipses and tracked celestial movements.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Mechanisms](https://www.justinhe.com/f): How songbirds learn to sing through sensory and sensorimotor phases, auditory feedback, critical periods, and neural circuitry.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Why every flat map distorts Earth, what projections preserve, and why Web Mercator dominates online maps.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Deep Ocean Light](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores the chemistry of bioluminescence, how deep-sea animals produce cold light, and its biological applications.
- [Roman Concrete Durability](https://www.justinhe.com/i): Why Roman concrete structures survive millennia while modern concrete fails, exploring volcanic ash chemistry and self-healing mechanisms.
